profile.headline: Principle Software Engineer at NG | ECE Masters at VT
profile.summary:
Huge fascination with machine learning algorithms, User Interfaces, and Electronic Systems. Believer that anything can be built on a breadboard.
Portfolio: https://andrew-garcia.my.canva.site/

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Bash shell scripts to automate payload data extraction in a Linux environment.​

Lead developer for mission critical image processing software that was used for decoding and displaying payload images as well as converting a series of images into a video format.

Lead software architect of a custom telemetry and image database using SQLite to improve data integrity and retrieval, as well as a GUI to interface with the database for downloads.​

Supported payload TVAC testing to ensure mission readiness.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed system performance software tools such as an Image Visualizer, Line of Sight analyzer, and Telemetry Plotter all using Python.​

Worked in an Agile environment to plan sprints and track software issues using Jira.​

Used Python to generate C++ command products for the payload to execute to complete sensor checkout phase.​

Built various plotting tools to visualize payload orbit, analyze payload performance, and determine focal plane orientation with respect to Earth.​

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created documentation and user guides for software to be delivered to our customer.​

Lead procurement manager for ordering necessary electronic components to develop a prototype spacecraft interface unit and power control unit.​

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Researched, competed, and developed a microgravity exercise machine prototype for the ISS and future deep space missions.
Awards:
- 2nd Place Best Design
- 2nd Place Best Poster
- 2nd Place Best Presentation
- 3rd Place Overall
Research was accepted and published in a peer reviewed journal Springer.

honors.title: Bravo for Operational Efficiency
honors.description: In recognition of your outstanding support to TO3 ready for operations
honors.issuer: Issued by Dominic Laico, Advanced Technology Program Manager · May 2021

honors.title: Bravo for People Leadership
honors.description: Thank you for your support of the Pathways Summit event on April 23rd, specifically helping facilitate the radiometry lunch and learn presentation with Kevin Rigg. The effort you put in to have an engaging opportunity to learn about our critical technology areas is immensely valuable.
honors.issuer: Issued by Kelsey Scott, Azusa Pathways Senior Manager · Apr 2021

publications.title: Modular multi-motor exercise system for space exploration

skills.name: Python, C++, C, and Assembly knowledgeable
Digital Multimeter, Power Supply, and Oscilloscope proficient
Proficient in NI Multisim (SPICE), AUtoCAD, SolidWorks, and Microsoft Visual
Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project proficiency
